title: Very Nice!
text: Very Nice!. This item is the perfect size for hanging in a bedroom! It’s not too small but not so big that it overwhelms the room. It is a bit smaller than the pictures make it look so pay attention to the measurements of the unit and also before buying knickknacks etc. for the individual shelves. The shelf as a whole seems to be well made. My only wish is that is has pre-drilled slots in the wood To hang up with instead of the clip style used but other wise worth it!

product_metadata.title: MyGift Rustic Shadow Box, 9-Compartment Torched Wooden Freestanding & Wall Mountable Knickknack Display Shelf, Curio Shelves
features: A rustic wood designed to freestanding or wall-mounted cubby display shelf
Boasts 9 compartments in various shapes and sizes to allow for versatile display options and eye-catching style
Small size cubby case for displaying small curios, collectibles, toys, awards, plants and more
Can be oriented vertically or horizontally (D-ring tabs are positioned for vertically oriented wall mounting, but can be repositioned for horizontal mounting)
Approximate Dimensions: Overall - 14.5 H x 11.8 W x 3 D. Largest Compartment - 6.50 L x 3.34 W. Smallest Compartment - 3.15 W x 3.07 D (in inches)
